title: Detailed magic wand
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='wand' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c98b3a'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#f0c060'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a86a28'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wandShade' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8a5418'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5e3608'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='starGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ffe680'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb820'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <g transform='rotate(35 50 50)'>
    <!-- handle shaft -->
    <rect x='45' y='38' width='10' height='52' rx='4' fill='url(#wand)'/>
    <rect x='45' y='38' width='3.5' height='52' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe0a0' opacity='0.75'/>
    <rect x='51.5' y='38' width='3.5' height='52' rx='1.5' fill='url(#wandShade)' opacity='0.8'/>
    <!-- spiral bindings -->
    <path d='M45 46 q10 4 10 10 q0 6 -10 10' stroke='#7a4a10' stroke-width='2' fill='none' opacity='0.85'/>
    <path d='M45 68 q10 4 10 10 q0 6 -10 10' stroke='#7a4a10' stroke-width='2' fill='none' opacity='0.85'/>
    <!-- grip bands -->
    <rect x='44' y='84' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a4a10'/>
    <rect x='44' y='55' width='12' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7a4a10' opacity='0.8'/>
    <!-- ferrule -->
    <rect x='43' y='33' width='14' height='8' rx='3' fill='#d8d8e8'/>
    <rect x='43' y='33' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
    <!-- star head -->
    <polygon points='50,2 55,20 72,14 60,28 78,33 60,38 72,52 55,46 50,64 45,46 28,52 40,38 22,33 40,28 28,14 45,20'
             fill='url(#starGlow)' stroke='#fff6c8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <polygon points='50,10 53,24 64,21 56,30 67,34 56,37 64,46 53,42 50,56 47,42 36,46 44,37 33,34 44,30 36,21 47,24'
             fill='#fffbe0' opacity='0.6'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff6b0'>
    <polygon points='20,22 22,28 28,30 22,32 20,38 18,32 12,30 18,28'/>
    <polygon points='82,18 83.5,22 88,24 83.5,26 82,30 80.5,26 76,24 80.5,22'/>
    <polygon points='80,72 81.5,76 86,78 81.5,80 80,84 78.5,80 74,78 78.5,76'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <circle cx='16' cy='62' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='58' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='12' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='90' r='1.7'/>
  </g>
</svg>
